0022600105.text: The Brooklyn Nets, who have not yet played a 2026-27 game, visit the Cleveland Cavaliers, who have also not yet played this season. Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder) is out for Brooklyn, while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) are out for Cleveland. In the 2025-26 season series, the Nets lost 0-3, with the most recent meeting on March 1, 2026 in Brooklyn ending in a 106-102 Nets loss.
